name: Kokoro no Kakera
source:
Our guy's father is leaving on a trip for two weeks and he has to take care of the house maids. That means he can chase after the 5 maids and 1 girlfriend. If he manage to catch a girl, his father won't be too happy but he will be extremely happy.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
我们那家伙的父亲要出差两周，他必须照顾女佣。这意味着他可以追5个女仆和1个女朋友。如果他能追到一个女孩，他的父亲不会太高兴，但他会高兴极了。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
